text: I am writing to request your support in amending the on-street parking regulation on the west side of Bleecker Street, south of Wellesley Street East in order to deter parking fronting the garbage loading zone of Fudger House Long-term Care Home located at 439 Sherbourne Street. Transportation Services staff recommends establishing a “No Standing Anytime” prohibition fronting the garbage loading zone in order to deter illegal parking in this area, and maintain unobstructed access. There will be no loss of on-street parking as a result of this parking amendment.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour parking regulation in effect at all times, on the west side of Bleecker Street, between Wellesley Street East and Carlton Street. 2. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour at all times, on the west side of Bleecker Street, between a point 32 metres north of Carlton Street and a point 87.5 metres south of Wellesley Street East. 3. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour at all times, on the west side of Bleecker Street, between Wellesley Street East and a point 55 metres south. 4. Rescinded the existing permit parking regulation in effect from 10:00 p.m. to 10:00 a.m. daily, except no parking 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, from a point 121 metres north of Carlton Street to a point 50 metres further north, on the even (west) side of Bleecker Street, from Wellesley…
